3068.title: Title-only error toasts hide overflow without recovery
3068.rootCauseOneLine: The title is always clamped to one line, while overflow detection and the Notification Center recovery action exist only in the optional description renderer.
3068.proposedFix: Share the existing overflow measurement and Show more control between toast titles and descriptions, preserving the one-line presentation while opening the recorded notification when either text field overflows.
3068.caveats: The general title-only toast defect was reproduced directly in the running app; the issue's specific server-conflict producer was not replayed end to end. Safari and mobile widths were not tested.
